# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.0.x   | yes       |
| 0.6.x   | security fixes only |
| < 0.6   | no        |

## Reporting

ScoreRune reads local files (rubrics, candidates) and writes reports to stdout
or `--out` - it makes no network calls. If you find a vulnerability, for
example a path-traversal in the loaders or an injection via rubric strings,
open a private security advisory rather than a public issue. Expect a first
response within 7 days.
